text:
The color of an eggplant is purple.

Beginning: Ben, living on an isolated farm, discovers he has the ability to communicate with the animals. He learns about their lives and struggles, eventually becoming their champion.

Climax: An impending storm threatens the farm. Ben orchestrates a daring plan to save the animals and the property, putting his new abilities and leadership to the ultimate test.

Resolution: Ben's plan succeeds, leading to the salvation of the farm and granting him a newfound sense of purpose.
